app.name: ControlHome
app.taglineDetail: Lights, energy and every room of your home in one quiet place, running on your own network.

roles.AdminDescription: Manages the home, its settings and the people who use it.

shell.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
shell.preferencesNotSaved: Applied here, but not saved to your profile.

validation.userName: Use 3 to 64 letters, digits, dots, underscores, hyphens or at signs.
validation.passwordLength: Use at least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
validation.coordinatesPair: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither.

live.stale: Device states may be out of date until then.

commands.superseded: Someone else changed this device just now.

dialog.title: Safety PIN
dialog.question: {action} {name}?
dialog.lockoutHint: After 5 wrong PINs, safety actions lock for 15 minutes.
dialog.setPin: Set your PIN in your profile

cover.pinHint: Opening asks for your safety PIN.

lock.jammed: The lock is jammed. Check it on the spot.
lock.pinHint: Unlocking asks for your safety PIN.

doorOpener.pinHint: Opening asks for your safety PIN.

appliance.remoteOff: Remote control is off on the appliance. Turn it on there to start or stop it from here.

camera.placeholder: Snapshots and live view arrive in a later version.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach ControlHome. Check that the server is running and you're on your home network.

request.not_found: That page or item doesn't exist.
request.invalid: The request wasn't valid. Reload the page and try again.
request.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
request.cross_origin: The request was blocked because it didn't come from ControlHome itself. Reload the page.
request.missing_header: The request was blocked by a security check. Reload the page.
request.network_denied: ControlHome only accepts connections from your home network.
request.host_denied: This address isn't allowed. Open ControlHome by its IP address or local name, or add this host name to the allowed list.
request.conflict: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
request.too_large: That's more data than ControlHome accepts in one request.

internal.error: ControlHome hit an unexpected error. Try again in a moment.

db.unavailable: The database isn't available right now. ControlHome keeps retrying on its own.
db.already_configured: A database is already connected. Reload the page to continue.
db.connection_failed: Couldn't connect to the database. Check the server address and the credentials.
db.create_denied: The database login isn't allowed to create the database. Create it with the script instead.
db.migration_failed: Updating the database failed. The server log has the details.
db.migrations_pending: The database is being updated. Try again in a moment.

sql.version_unsupported: ControlHome needs SQL Server 2025 or later.
sql.compatibility_unsupported: The database must use compatibility level 170 (SQL Server 2025).

setup.invalid_code: That setup code isn't right. Copy it again from the server log or setup-code.txt.
setup.already_completed: This home is already set up. Sign in instead.

auth.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
auth.locked_out: This account is locked for a while after too many failed attempts.
auth.disabled: This account is disabled. Ask an administrator to enable it.
auth.reset_invalid: This reset link is invalid, already used or expired. Run reset-admin again for a new one.

users.not_found: That person no longer has an account.
users.last_admin: The home needs at least one active administrator. Promote someone else first.
users.cannot_delete_self: You can't delete your own account.
users.duplicate_username: That user name is already taken.

floors.concurrency: Someone else changed this floor while you were editing. Reload it to see their changes.

rooms.not_found: That room is no longer on this floor. Reload the floor and try again.

geometry.too_few_points: A room needs at least 3 corners.
geometry.too_many_points: This room has too many corners. Simplify its outline.
geometry.self_intersecting: The room's walls cross or touch each other. Move the corners so the outline doesn't overlap itself.
geometry.out_of_bounds: Part of the room is outside the floor. Move it inside or make the floor bigger.
geometry.zero_area: The room has no area. Spread its corners apart.

files.not_found: That image no longer exists. Upload it again.
files.unsupported_type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
files.too_large: The image is too big. Use one of at most 10 MB and 40 megapixels.
files.invalid_image: The image couldn't be read. It may be damaged; try exporting it again.

devices.not_found: That device no longer exists. Reload the page.

endpoints.not_found: That device control no longer exists. Reload the page.

integrations.not_found: That integration no longer exists. Reload the page.
integrations.invalid_config: Some settings aren't valid. Check the highlighted fields.

connectors.not_found: That kind of integration isn't available in this version.

commands.invalid_arguments: The device can't take that value.
commands.argument_unknown: This device doesn't have that setting.
commands.argument_invalid_type: That isn't the right kind of value.
commands.argument_out_of_range: That value is outside the device's range.
commands.argument_not_on_step: Pick a value on the device's steps.
commands.argument_not_allowed: The device doesn't support that option.
commands.argument_too_long: That text is too long for the device.
commands.unsupported: This device doesn't support that action.
commands.gate_closed: The device doesn't accept remote control right now. Turn on remote control on the device itself.
commands.unavailable: This device's integration isn't running right now. Try again in a moment.
commands.timed_out: The device didn't confirm in time. Check its state.
commands.failed: The action didn't work. Try again.
commands.not_confirmed: The device reported that the action didn't happen (for example, a jammed lock). Check it on site.

safety.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Safety actions are locked for a while.
safety.not_allowed: You aren't allowed to do this safety action.
safety.pin_not_set: Set a safety PIN in your profile first.
safety.password_required: Enter your account password to set a new safety PIN.

runtime.standby: This ControlHome instance is a read-only standby. Make the change on the instance that runs your devices.
runtime.starting: ControlHome is still starting its device runtime. Try again in a moment.
